description: This file defines the AzureAISearchContentFieldMapper class responsible for mapping content fields to Azure Search index mappings within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles indexing content items, creating index mappings, and invoking index event handlers.

classes.name: AzureAISearchContentFieldMapper
classes.description: A class responsible for mapping content fields to Azure Search index entries, handling index creation, and invoking index event handlers within OrchardCore.

methods.name: MapAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously maps content item fields to Azure Search index mappings, creating index entries for content types.

methods.name: AddIndexMappingAsync
methods.description: Adds or updates index mappings for a given field, handling vector types and invoking index event handlers.
